title: Aircraft instruments go haywire at edge of the bubble

tellings.quote: We've even had fixed-wing aircraft that actually document that there's something that their their instruments their instruments go haywire.

plain: On a podcast episode with podcast host Jesse Michels about Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, a speaker from the ranch describes an invisible zone over the property that they call a bubble. They say fixed-wing aircraft flying there have recorded that something is present, because their instruments go haywire at its edge. If true, it would mean something unseen over the ranch can interfere with aircraft.
